Synonyms include hair gel, hair wax, grease, finish paste, and, in certain contexts, wood polish. Antonyms are products that reduce hold or gloss, such as dry shampoo, matte powder, or non-styling cleansers. More specific forms of pomade include water-based pomade, oil-based pomade, scented pomade, wood polish pomade, and oil finish pomade. Historically, pomades were made from fats or oils and were valued for their ability to smooth and control hair. Today they remain popular in barbering and personal grooming, especially for styles requiring shine, definition, and lasting hold.
